## Install

Download **`smaran-*.apk`** below and open it on your Android phone. The first time, Android asks you to allow
installs from your browser or file manager. An update installs over the old version and keeps your library.

To check the download, compare its SHA-256 with the `.sha256` file: `sha256sum smaran-*.apk`.

> **Subscription sign-in** (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) reuses the official CLI tools' public OAuth clients. It may
> violate those providers' terms, and it can stop working without warning. API keys are the supported path.
> [Read more](https://github.com/Ankit3794/smaran#subscription-sign-in-read-this-first).
>
> **Privacy:** your library stays on your phone. Only the link goes to the site, and the post text goes to the AI
> you pick. [What leaves your phone](https://github.com/Ankit3794/smaran#what-leaves-your-phone).
